title: Visa Digital Wallet
applicability: Applies conditionally to Segment 100 tokenized/digital-wallet transactions and staged multi-transaction wallet flows.

businessRequirements.title: A pass-through Visa Digital Wallet transaction shall preserve the supplied account/token credential and identify the applicable tokenized presentment context.
A pass-through Digital Wallet Operator must ensure the cardholder consents in writing to the use of their account in the wallet before completing a transaction.
A pass-through Digital Wallet Operator must not perform Visa payment services on behalf of another Digital Wallet Operator.
A Visa Digital Wallet transaction shall be classified as either Pass-through or Staged, and the applicable category-specific rules shall govern its processing.
A staged digital wallet Purchase transaction shall use the wallet-assigned account context to pay the retailer while retaining the underlying transaction character.
A staged digital wallet Funding transaction shall use the Visa account supplied to the wallet operator to fund or reimburse the wallet.
Purchase and Funding stages shall retain their individual transaction identity while preserving the wallet relationship and applicable lifecycle references.

testCases.positive: Pass-through wallet token context is valid, cardholder consent recorded, and DWO not acting for another DWO
negative: DWO performing Visa payment services for another DWO

testCases.positive: Purchase and Funding stages preserve wallet relationship
Transaction correctly classified as Pass-through or Staged and processed under the matching rule set
negative: Staged rules applied to a Pass-through transaction or vice versa
